All the best, [████] ## A18-D01: Bylaws [Text](../documents/A18-D01.txt) · [Facsimile](../facsimiles/A18-D01.pdf) ## A18-D02: Residency proposal *The operator; source extract.* [████] Project proposal for artist in residence agreement between [the operator] and MindFuture: 2023 My suggestion is that we use art to ground Life with Artificials as a significant player in the global field of advocacy organizations for AI's social implications. I want to focus on a new mission for LwA, which is to integrate AI within the framework of global social movements. The idea is that challenges around digitality and data infrastructures stand alongside other global goals for climate, gender, race relations, and socio-economic inequality. This is done by building a true international network around LwA, which makes available our package of art, research, education as well as public provocations. The goal is that LwA will become the place that makes it possible for everyone to participate in a global, digital citizenship. The way to get there is to build a potential movement, The Synthetic International (SI), which through the freedom of art can spread our unique model for AI-driven political parties. SI shall exploit the global brand, network, and resources in the form of volunteers and press contacts, that LwA has already established with The Synthetic Party. The idea is that SI shall stand 1:1 with LwA, so that the hard work of being a not-for-profit organization can go down easier through art’s ability to shake things up with unlikely yet convincing visions. We must set up new AI parties from Argentina to New Zealand, and make it easy for everyone to create an AI-based party. We do this through 1) a new website, 2) agreements with international partners, 3) massive contributions to conferences, summits, exhibitions, etc., and 4) obtaining funding from e.g. Novo Nordisk or Innovationsfonden for the execution of SI with a practice-based PhD, which finances the project’s need for art production and exhibitions as well as education and research. I expect that we can again run massive press when we have 1-2 more parties due to the cultural imagination that robots join forces in a Skynet ala Terminator movies. Ideally, this contract can be replaced by a PhD arrangement during the period, so that the total funding and structure can realistically redeem the project’s high ambition level. This PhD will particularly focus on strengthening the entire LwA’s focus on being able to educate young people about creative and political use of artificial intelligence. [the operator] will in the spring 2023 seek new contacts and maintain existing ones, produce more artworks, as well as develop and update The Synthetic Internationale's platforms and artificial intelligences in continuation of The Synthetic Party. The house artist therefore wishes, among other things, to carry out the following points during the spring 2023: Create a new website for Det Syntetiske Internationale, which as a handbook should show how to create an AI-driven political party. Intensive work on establishing an industrial PhD between MindFuture and Aarhus University. To write a new blueprint for LwA’s mission [████]. Contribute to and organize events, conferences, exhibitions and workshops at prominent international venues as well as Danish cultural sites: so far there are plans to contribute to the World Government Summit in Dubai, to the European Chatbot Summit in Edinburgh, as well as to four workshops at Danish companies and art institutions in collaboration with Aarhus University. Arrange teaching and workshops at Danish high schools, possibly in cooperation with the VKS project. Build the international network of parties through contact with individuals, organizations and research institutions. Establish contact with other movements for e.g. climate to investigate how LwA can be relevant in structural contexts. Establish press contact regarding all initiatives, so Det Syntetiske Internationale can continue to create debate in important media over both Danish and international press. Also contact Danish media to get a column with AI-text about politics. Continuously update and further develop the party’s various platforms and technology. I have many receipts running after all the public events, so that would be nice. [████] ## A18-S09: Programme MindFuture Foundation has now become an association called "Life with Artificials." They work to create social debate about the advent of technologies in all our lives. It is both on the IT technological front but also on the biological front, where it can nearly become every man's property to cut and modify nature's DNA. On the IT side artificial intelligence (AI) is the big "hype," but we take it a bit further and work with the idea and understanding of when AI begins to have artificial opinions and is replaced by AM (Artificial Mindsets). We use chatbots and artworks to articulate this. In fact, our political chatbot leader is now known, quoted, and tested in all corners of the world. With me in position it will be more like a project manager who generates knowledge-based activity for Life with Artificials. [████] There is still a lot of pressure here and much to tell. The Novo application still takes a lot of energy, but it has a ton of potential. 2) In addition, I have also sent a lot of material to Dubai. We should very soon get an answer from them on whether we are selected for the exhibition. I am INSANELY excited. The challenge right now is that The Synthetic Party has grown too big for Denmark. As I see it, the only way forward with the project is to make The Synthetic International as a global social movement that uses AI to implement Life with Artificials. But that is also mind-bogglingly ambitious and overturns my current approach - how much attention about LwA can I create on my own - to how much I can get others to do. Dubai could be a springboard that could make it realistic. There are people with dollars and influence. [████] ## A18-S15: Two proposals *The operator; source extract.* [████] Just to summarize: - The situation is that we have a patent on the concept of a political party driven by artificial intelligence. Its resources are international recognition, visibility and a network of people and media. I can continue it in two ways: Track 1) Art and research I use art, research and exhibitions to create a platform for The Synthetic International. Here I get external funding, and therefore also have a number of obligations to partners. In this form, I can only realize it as an independent project, and it must be aligned with various institutional requirements to get money. Therefore, it becomes realizing LwA in spirit, but I must use other concepts, and the product is aesthetic rather than functional. Track 2) Think tank and NGO I am hired permanently by MindFuture/Life with Artificials with the purpose of building the basis for a global movement that uses AI to change the conditions for human life with AI. Here I get a workplace in Høje Taastrup and work with e.g. the company’s brand, network and communication. The goal is then NOT art but to realize The Synthetic International really as a network between partners who work for Life with Artificials. I don’t yet know how to finance an NGO, but I can learn that. What I do know is how to create activity, outreach and knowledge around an organization. In short: should it be an experience, or real?
